trigger_reasons: standards: trust boundary for session cookies
summary: Session cookie is set without Secure and HttpOnly flags on a sensitive auth path.

findings.trigger: Issue a session after login and inspect Set-Cookie.
findings.expected: Session cookie includes HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, and a restrictive Path.
findings.actual: Only Path=/ is set; cookie is readable by script and sendable on cleartext if exposed.
findings.impact: XSS can steal the session; mixed-content or mis-terminated TLS increases theft risk.
findings.fix: Set HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax or Strict; avoid overly broad Path if applicable.
findings.evidence_detail: The Set-Cookie string literal contains no HttpOnly or Secure attributes.

non_findings: No hardcoded long-lived API keys in the supplied session module.
Token value itself is not logged in the supplied snippet.
open_questions: Is TLS terminated at a proxy that already rewrites cookie flags? Not in packet.
